scope: Static source audit and one failed noninteractive read-only SSH inventory attempt; no serial device opened, no command sent, no service/configuration change, no synthesis/simulation or hardware action
user_wiring_fact: Existing USB-TTL is already connected to P11-40; user will move USB host end to RK, FPGA-side wiring unchanged

navigation_uart.tx_sequence_meaning: Incremented on TX_GO accepted while not busy; not task execution or remote delivery confirmation
navigation_uart.reply_storage: Latest message only; writes update shadow before GO increments sequence; no independently locked UART snapshot proven
navigation_uart.map_integrity: MAP_ACK next_offset/state plus body CRC32 at MAP_END
navigation_uart.reply_failure_gap: hal_host_send false on busy is not retried by current STATUS/send_ack callers; reply may be dropped/overwritten
navigation_uart.target_timeout_behavior: Approximately 1.5 seconds without fresh TARGET returns TRACK to SEARCH, not ESTOP

frame.crc: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE, init FFFF/poly1021, version+length+payload, little-endian transmitted CRC

control_uart.independent_speed_rx_gap: Valid target held until new valid packet/reset; 10ms timeout is only incomplete-frame discard; no command-age stop/ACK/sequence

sfp_removal_contract.control_tap_implementation: Separate double 128-byte slots, read-only original UART bytes, NV 0x83 130-byte packet, mailbox priority; no TXB or TX_SEQ write
sfp_removal_contract.HOST_EXTENSION_1_reset: host_mbx selects h_core_rst; no-SFP must provide still-valid protocol reset

rk_local_implementation.stable_identity_rule: Prefer actual unique USB serial/by-id; if absent/duplicate, verified fixed ID_PATH/by-path. VID/PID-only is insufficient for same-model adapters; do not rely on tty enumeration order

rk_remote_inventory.method: One BatchMode=yes StrictHostKeyChecking=yes ConnectTimeout=8 read-only SSH command for hostname/date/lsusb/by-id/by-path and selected service state
pending: actual two USB devices attached to RK

pending_test_sequence: Physical/image/timing gates and current power/support facts, then read-only USB identity and exclusive ownership
NAV0 and MODE idle/stop through sole R0 owner; correlate fresh STATUS and physical feedback, not K or TX_SEQ alone
Zero-command disconnect/reconnect and no stale replay; explicitly not moving-link-loss-stop proof
MAP offsets/final state/body CRC rejection and task-state acceptance with STATUS/ACK interleaving
After required host-loss policy and N2/N3 gates, supported low-amplitude motion/stop tests; no Flash
